remarks:
Welcome to 1579 Lakeview Road, featuring one-level living with a functionally updated design.
The updated floor plan seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining and living areas, creating an open and inviting main living space that feels considerably larger than its 1,459 square feet suggests.
Boasting distinctive architectural character, the home features vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings with exposed beams throughout and a striking, double-sided, wood-burning brick fireplace.
The oversized kitchen and dining area features white cabinetry, a built-in pantry, stainless-steel appliances, seamless marble countertops and backsplash, and a large center island.
A 12-foot double sliding patio door opens directly from the kitchen onto the rear patio, filling the space with natural light and creating easy indoor-outdoor flow for entertaining in the level backyard.
The home offers two bedrooms, a den/office area and 1.5 updated baths, along with convenient in-bath laundry. A separate exterior entrance provides direct access to the bathroom from the backyard, an especially convenient feature for outdoor entertaining.
Wood-look tile flooring runs throughout the entire home, creating a cohesive, low-maintenance design.
Additional features include an attached two-car garage with a rear garage door providing convenient access directly to the backyard, public water and sewer, a newer rear roof section, and a level 0.293-acre lot in Lake View within the Frontier Central School District.
Thoughtfully updated while preserving its original character, this home blends modern functionality with the warmth and charm of a cozy, modern cabin—all with the convenience of true one-level living.
Public open house this Saturday 10/17/2026 from 11am to 2pm.
